summary: A quiet-volume but friction-heavy week. The July 15-31 invoice (plus an unpaid balance carried from the prior period) is still outstanding: Lauryn tried to pay Aug 7 but reported ALTR's Zelle email isn't working and got no answer from Stephski by week's end. Late Aug 7-8, Derrek escalated her long-running 'Facebook not recommended' problem to Meta rep Vivek, but the fix stalled when Vivek asked her to unlink/verify via her Gmail, which she flatly refused on security grounds ('That's just confidential'). Her tone stays warm and cooperative, but she now has an unpaid invoice blocked on our side's payment rails and a trust-sensitive security ask hanging open.

health.rationale: Client remains friendly and engaged, but week closed with an overdue/blocked payment, an unanswered Zelle question, an unresolved months-old Facebook restriction, and new trust friction over the Gmail access request.

client_priorities: Account security and confidentiality - refuses to share Gmail access, wary of scam emails and 'scammy' requests, protective of login/recovery credentials
Facebook/IG growth and algorithm health - getting the FB page recommended again is her top ongoing ask ('Gotta have page be able to have endless traction')
Brand protection - DMCA leak takedowns matter to her ('My biggest thing is when they type... My Name with Naked' shows nothing), and quickly killing fake TG/impersonation accounts
Firm content boundaries - no explicit/nude/implied-sex customs (no 'fake masturbation', no implied oral), even at the cost of refunds; she must be portrayed consistently with her music/brand career
Revenue growth with flexible payment timing - motivated to 'run it up' each month but needs invoices split and timed to OnlyFans payout drops
suggestions: Get Stephski to answer the Aug 7 Zelle question immediately with verified working payment details (email AND phone) - the client was actively trying to pay and was left hanging

Have Vivek deliver step-by-step instructions for completing the Google/Facebook verification entirely on Lauryn's end - never re-ask for Gmail credentials; her security stance is firm and repeated requests will erode trust
Give her a realistic status and timeline cadence (e.g. weekly update) on the Facebook 'not recommended' fix - this complaint has resurfaced since September 2025 with no resolution
Proactively offer a standing split-invoice arrangement aligned to her OF payout dates so payment chasing (and the carried-balance situation) stops recurring
Stabilize banking/payment details - this is at least the fourth payment-rail change; each one has directly delayed her payments
wins: Derrek personally jumped in the same night the FB issue resurfaced (Aug 7) and looped in the dedicated Meta rep, then defused the Gmail concern with a clear, respectful clarification
Client proactively attempted payment on Aug 7 without further chasing - intent to pay is clearly there
Weekly DMCA leak-removal updates keep landing on schedule (2,301+ infringements removed to date), a service she consistently thanks the team for
